excludedGlobfpFootprints.description: 车公庙深南大道南侧辅路的开敞分流段。影像可辨车道标线和分流鼻端，北侧高架是独立对象。

globfpMisidentified.rule: GloBFP-only, area<300 m2, and (>= 60% inside OSM plaza/green or >= 80% inside ground carriageway buffer 1 m)

overtureMisidentified.rule: Overture-only (no OSM building), area<300 m2, and (>= 60% inside OSM plaza/green or >= 80% inside ground carriageway buffer 1 m)

processing.coverage: full bounding rectangle; render with separate land and water polygons

limitations: 25 m output grid does not increase native source resolution
Source snapshot is not a current ground survey; buildings and canopy may affect DEM
Terrain not yet connected to runtime surfaces or controllers
Water surface and bridge deck elevations require separate source data
Conditional access is not yet imported
Bridge and tunnel vertical profiles require source verification; layer is not height
Unresolved vertical links are excluded from traffic and automatic driving
Via-way relations use conservative entry filtering
Conditional access is not modeled

baseline.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus Copernicus attribution terms; commercial licensing is separate
baseline.attribution: FABDEM V1-2 (University of Bristol) contains modified Copernicus GLO-30 elevation data; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus Copernicus attribution terms.

rule.referenceRule: reference = median_filter(min(median_filter(FABDEM), original DSM runtime height), 7) with nodata fallbacks; lowering only
rule.plateauBufferRule: nearest station half width + 1.5 * terrain step
rule.transitionRule: width = clip(|profile - original DSM| / maxTransitionSlope, minTransitionM, maxTransitionM)

plateauRelaxation.scope: derived vertices only; original terrain is a fixed boundary

insideStepLimit.scope: adjacent derived vertices inside one corridor, with the raise cap applied

steepTerrainExclusion.rule: terrain cells steeper than this keep the original DSM

nodeLevelRelaxation.rule: shared node levels relaxed so endpoints fit the class grade allowance

rule.junctionContinuity: shared nodes use the median of incident resolved link reference endpoints
rule.method: FABDEM station baseline median-filtered to reject residual building/canopy spikes, then reduced to min(filtered FABDEM, original DSM runtime height) per station with nodata fallbacks; the reference series is median-filtered again; shared nodes pinned to the median incident reference endpoint and relaxed within the class grade allowance; class grade clamp with forward/backward passes; flat cross-section; plateau radius = nearest station half width + 1.5 terrain steps; adaptive smoothstep transition (15 m minimum, widened where the profile differs from the DSM); bounded Laplacian relaxation and an inside-corridor single-cell step limit; derived vertices never exceed the original DSM by more than the raise cap; quantized to terrain heightScale

reference.rule: reference = min(median-filtered FABDEM, original DSM runtime height), then median-filtered
reference.definition: biasM = median reference - median original DSM along the centreline; positive means the reference still sits above the DSM

limitations: FABDEM is a modelled DTM (source GLO-30 mainly 2011-2015) and still contains residual building and canopy height in dense areas; the derived surface is an explicitly estimated engineering surface, not measured elevation
The derived surface is a de-contamination (lowering) pass only: it never exceeds the original DSM by more than the raise cap, so the DSM absolute level and building bases stay consistent
Where the original DSM is contaminated upward over a whole link, min(FABDEM, DSM) cannot remove all of it; the residual is capped by the raise cap and reported as capped vertices
Bridge, tunnel and layer links keep the original terrain and are not smoothed
Links without a complete FABDEM station profile keep the original terrain; the list is capped
Links with any station inside a locked terrain exclusion polygon keep the original terrain
The flat cross-section ignores real superelevation, cross fall, kerb and sidewalk level changes
A link whose two node elevations exceed the class grade allowance keeps both nodes (network continuity wins) and is reported as grade-infeasible
The transition band is widened on purpose where the derived surface differs a lot from the DSM, so the modified footprint can exceed half width + 1.5 steps + 15 m in contaminated areas
OSM snapshot membership, not a live operator station/entrance inventory
Unassociated candidates are excluded from confirmed station and entrance layers
Combined ref 2;8 services retain both line references on shared track
Vertical track elevations are unresolved; layer and level are not metres
Not yet attached to scene or maps
simulated-street / simulated-park 是按道路等级、绿地面积和固定种子布置的外观估计，不是单株实测，不能当作市政种植清单或实时植被数据。
只有 PBF 里 natural=tree / natural=tree_row 的点位有来源；没有 height / diameter_crown 标签的树，树高和冠幅按树种范围估计（appearance=species-estimate）。
树龄没有数据来源，未建模。
避让只按本地几何判定建筑退让 2 m、水体、湿地、车行道、pedestrian 广场走廊和已知步道；树池、地下管线、架空线、入口净空未核实。
广场避让来自 OSM highway=pedestrian/place=square 的线状和面状对象；其他未映射的铺装广场仍可能被补种。
绿地图层包含山体林地（面积远大于城市公园），受 60000 株总量上限约束，非地标绿地按面积配额等距抽样，密度低于满铺。
树种从固定权重表里按种子抽取，不对应深圳市政实际种植清单。
